Class MazeVisuals

java.lang.Object
dev.despical.mazeengine.service.visual.MazeVisuals
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable, org.bukkit.event.Listener
public final class MazeVisuals extends Object implements org.bukkit.event.Listener, AutoCloseable
Owns private previews and route guides anchored to maze world coordinates.

The service delegates session creation to preview and guide managers, budgets display spawning on a server ticker, updates routes as viewers move, and combines their status in one action bar. Preview geometry planning uses a bounded worker queue; entity and chunk ownership stays on the server thread.

Sessions end on expiry, viewer disconnect, relevant world unload, or obsolete maze state. Reload refreshes display appearance and invalidates guide geometry while captured expiry times remain intact. Closing stops planning and ticking and releases displays and chunk leases for every session.
